aid-package.title: Aid package
aid-package.text: Local partners offer emergency support. Choose what you need most.

community-garden-proposal.title: Community garden
community-garden-proposal.text: Residents propose creating a community garden by the forest. It'll strengthen local ties and ecological awareness.

eco-champion-award.title: Green Leader Award
eco-champion-award.text: Your pro-environment actions were recognized. You can allocate the award to a modernization promo or to the budget.

supplier-mou.title: Supplier memorandum
supplier-mou.text: A supplier proposes a memorandum of understanding. In exchange for brand promotion – better terms on modernizations.

supplier-mou-commitment.title: Commitment from memorandum
supplier-mou-commitment.text: The partner asks for campaign support according to the memorandum terms. You can contribute now or risk cooling relations.

community-protest.title: Residents' discontent
community-protest.text: Some residents criticize recent decisions. You can organize consultations or ignore the dissenting voices.

choices.hold-consult: Consultations and small fixes (−8 ViCoins, −3 pollution)

press-critique.title: Press critique
press-critique.text: Media point to poor air quality and lack of action. Shops raise parts and service prices.

supplier-delay.title: Delivery delays
supplier-delay.text: Suppliers signal logistic issues. Poor relations don't help. You have two options.

choices.wait-longer: Wait it out (−6% prices for 30 s later)

toasts.wait-longer: Delay compensation active: a small discount.

municipal-partnership.title: Municipal partnership
municipal-partnership.text: The municipality proposes cooperation on a modernization campaign. You can focus on education or obtain co-funding for upgrades.

compliance-plan.title: Compliance plan
compliance-plan.text: High pollution levels attract regulator attention. They propose a remediation plan or you can defer actions at the risk of further air quality decline.

choices.accept-plan: Implement plan (−8 pollution, −8% prices for 45 s)

winter-prep-supplies.title: Winter supplies
winter-prep-supplies.text: Frost is coming. You can secure supplies and negotiate discounts for upgrades or gamble and save now.

choices.save-now: Save now (+10 ViCoins, +0.02 pollution/s for 20 s)

toasts.save-now: Received 10 ViCoins. Watch out for short-term emissions.

retrofit-fair-invite.title: Invitation to retrofit fair
retrofit-fair-invite.text: You receive an invitation to a local retrofit fair. Participating may bring benefits.

retrofit-fair-followup.title: Follow-up after fair
retrofit-fair-followup.text: Organizers propose a joint info campaign in your area.

choices.campaign: Let's do it! (−8% prices for 60 s)

winter-audit-check.title: Winter audit
winter-audit-check.text: Authorities check frost preparedness. Order and clean combustion can bring a small bonus, neglect – reprimand.

choices.skip-audit: Do not provide information (−3 pollution now)

grant-boiler-exchange.title: Boiler exchange program
grant-boiler-exchange.text: The municipality launches subsidies for greener heating sources. For a limited time you can benefit and modernize more cheaply.

summer-solar-push.title: Solar summer
summer-solar-push.text: Exceptionally sunny forecast for the coming days. It's a great time to invest in renewables and cut bills.

pellet-supply-crunch.title: Pellet logistics
pellet-supply-crunch.text: Seasonal demand spike drives pellet prices and extends deliveries. A supplier offers a discount on other upgrades in exchange for a long-term contract.

frost-warning.title: Frost warning
frost-warning.text: Forecasters predict severe frost. You can prepare your installation now or risk higher wear during cooling.

tech-expo-audit.title: Tech‑Expo audit
tech-expo-audit.text: Your installation was singled out as an example of modernization. Organizers offer a research grant or promo campaign.
